scope_note: Only workflows with real, inspectable case evidence and explicit scientific boundaries are public. Human browser, GUI, manual, terminal, and HPC actions form one research route; exact replay remains supporting evidence. Legacy recipe routes remain migration surfaces, not a second workflow directory.

workflows.title: Silicon Ground-State and Electronic-Structure Workflow
workflows.summary: Follow a real COD Silicon structure through model inspection, numerical setup, reference calculations, bands, DOS, plots, and bounded interpretation using separately recorded real QE 7.5 evidence.
workflows.evidence_boundary: Program completion, SCF convergence, ionic convergence, expected-artifact presence, target-observable convergence, and scientific support are separate decisions.
workflows.continuity_boundary: The public case is an assembled set of hash-bound, separately recorded real QE 7.5 stages. It does not claim one continuous historical launcher, case-wide shell-exit transcript, execution interval, or cross-route save-tree ancestry.
workflows.claim_boundary: This assembled public case does not establish one continuous historical launcher, transferable cutoff or k mesh, a converged band gap or DOS, structural stability, experimental agreement, or a material-level conclusion.

first_action.label: Open the Silicon source record before preparing a calculation
first_action.boundary: This action exposes the downloaded structure, its representation receipt, and the pseudopotential identity record. It does not prepare or launch QE, accept the model, or establish numerical suitability.

execution_contexts.label: Local interactive execution
execution_contexts.allowed_when: Only when local and site policy permits calculation on the current machine and sufficient resources are available.
execution_contexts.boundary: Never assume that an SSH login shell or cluster login node is a permitted compute context.

execution_contexts.label: Slurm allocation or batch execution
execution_contexts.allowed_when: Only inside an active compute allocation or a site-approved batch job.
execution_contexts.boundary: Use the site's documented launcher inside the allocation. Translate the displayed direct pw.x invocation into the reviewed site command; neither a shell variable nor an SSH login grants permission to compute on a login node.

evidence_tracks.label: Reconstruct the stored public evidence
evidence_tracks.output_policy: Rebuild only the case-derived tables, figures, manifest relationships, and isolated-copy checks from committed source/input/output records.
audit: Confirm that parsing starts from the declared stored raw outputs.
Retain solver warnings and time-reversal-reduced sampling labels.
Check artifact relationships and hashes without treating them as observable convergence.
evidence_tracks.parse_plot_boundary: These commands parse and plot the stored public record; they do not prove that a new DFT calculation ran.
evidence_tracks.boundary: Stored reconstruction supports parser and artifact lineage only, not historical continuity, fresh execution, target-observable convergence, or scientific acceptance.

evidence_tracks.label: Run a fresh relaxation and static SCF, then stop
commands: QE_PW=${QE_PW:?Set QE_PW to the absolute path to pw.x}

awk '/Forces acting on atoms/{block=$0 ORS; inside=1; next} inside{block=block $0 ORS} inside && /Total force =/{last=block; inside=0} END{if (last == "") exit 1; printf "%s", last}' "$runtime/relax/si-relax.out"
ACCEPT_RELAX_GEOMETRY=${ACCEPT_RELAX_GEOMETRY:?After inspecting the final force block, criteria, constraints, and coordinates, set ACCEPT_RELAX_GEOMETRY=yes}
awk '/^Begin final coordinates/{seen=1; next} seen && /^ATOMIC_POSITIONS/{print; getline; print; getline; print; exit}' "$runtime/relax/si-relax.out" > "$runtime/reference/final-positions.inc"

awk 'FNR==NR {replacement[++n]=$0; next} /^ATOMIC_POSITIONS[[:space:]]/ {for (i=1; i<=n; i++) print replacement[i]; skip=2; next} skip {skip--; next} {print}' "$runtime/reference/final-positions.inc" "$case_root/input/scf.in" > "$runtime/reference/static-scf.in"
grep -Fqx '   JOB DONE.' "$runtime/reference/static-scf.out"; grep -F 'convergence has been achieved' "$runtime/reference/static-scf.out"; test -d "$runtime/reference/out/si_cod9013102.save"
printf '%s\n' 'STOP: no fresh bands or DOS calculation is supplied here; inspect the stored branches separately.'
evidence_tracks.output_policy: Use one new caller-selected external directory for the fresh relax-to-static-SCF lineage; never overwrite committed evidence or reuse the older bands/DOS files as descendants.
audit: Record the shell exit and inspect every stdout and stderr independently.
Check program termination separately from electronic SCF convergence.
For relaxation, inspect ionic criteria, final coordinates, forces, and constraints rather than JOB DONE alone.
Confirm every expected downstream artifact before parsing or interpretation.
Test the selected target observable with its own numerical convergence protocol.
State the scientific claim only after the evidence supports it.
evidence_tracks.parse_plot_boundary: No fresh bands or DOS parsing is attempted. The public stored bands, DOS, tables, and plots remain a separate historical evidence set.
evidence_tracks.boundary: This present-day route creates a direct fresh relaxation-to-static-SCF lineage and stops there. The new static SCF is not the parent of the stored bands or DOS; a future compatible bands/NSCF/DOS branch must inherit this new prefix, outdir, and save tree and has not been prepared or run here.

stages.label: Obtain the source structure
stages.purpose: Open the COD record, read its metadata, download and visually inspect the CIF, then bind the starting crystal to the public source before changing its representation.

action.label: Inspect the downloaded CIF and its source receipt
action.boundary: This inspection binds the starting record and recorded representation notes. It does not accept the transformed model or launch QE.

stages.boundary: A database structure is a source record, not yet an accepted DFT model.

stages.label: Build the computational model
stages.purpose: Compare the conventional COD cell and the declared two-site primitive QE representation visually and numerically before accepting the transformation.

action.label: Compare the source and two-site QE representations
action.boundary: The displayed transform is a model choice to inspect and record. It is not a relaxation, stability test, or model ranking.

stages.boundary: The representation is NOT_RANKED and is not a relaxation, stability result, or proof of method suitability.

stages.label: Obtain and verify the pseudopotential
stages.purpose: Inspect the SSSP family and potential metadata, then acquire the exact declared archive member without redistributing it.

action.label: Download and verify the declared Silicon potential
action.boundary: The case preparation script fails closed on the recorded CIF, archive, member, model, and pseudopotential identities. A successful identity check does not establish transferability or convergence.

stages.boundary: Exact bytes establish identity only, not transferability or numerical convergence.

stages.label: Prepare the Quantum ESPRESSO inputs
stages.purpose: Inspect the recorded calculation types, model, method, cutoffs, sampling, and output locations before execution.

action.label: Read the inputs before launching anything
commands: for input in si-relax.in scf.in bands.in bands.x.in dos-nscf.in dos.x.in; do printf '\n### %s\n' "$input"; sed -n '1,180p' "$case_root/input/$input"; done
action.boundary: Confirm calculation type, geometry, prefix, outdir, pseudo_dir, cutoffs, occupations, and k sampling before execution. These recorded values are not universal recommendations.

stages.boundary: The stored PBE, cutoff, k-mesh, and sampling settings are case records, not transferable recommendations.

stages.label: Run the calculation
stages.purpose: Start a new fixed-cell relaxation in an empty external directory. The later reference-geometry and SCF stages continue this fresh lineage; the broad run.sh replay template remains a separate optional case record.

action.label: Run one fresh fixed-cell relaxation
commands: QE_PW=${QE_PW:?Set QE_PW to the absolute path to pw.x}
action.boundary: This launches only the fresh relaxation. It neither executes the case-wide replay template nor creates bands or DOS evidence.

stages.boundary: The direct action creates a new relaxation record only. The replay template does not establish the historical launcher or case-wide continuity.

stages.label: Check program and solver outcomes
stages.purpose: Separate program termination, electronic convergence, ionic evidence, warnings, and artifact presence.
command_stages: rebuild derived artifacts from stored outputs

action.label: Inspect the fresh relaxation outcome
commands: grep -nE 'convergence has been achieved|bfgs converged|End of BFGS Geometry Optimization|JOB DONE|Error in routine' "$runtime/relax/si-relax.out"
action.boundary: Inspect the final complete force block, declared ionic criteria, final coordinates, constraints, stderr, and termination separately. JOB DONE alone is insufficient.

stages.boundary: JOB DONE and parser success do not establish ionic convergence, target-observable convergence, or scientific support.

stages.label: Test the required numerical convergence
stages.purpose: Inspect the recorded cutoff/k-mesh matrix without promoting it beyond its declared scope.

action.label: Read the stored convergence matrix before choosing settings
action.boundary: This is an exploratory total-energy matrix. It supplies no accepted stable-tail result for bands, DOS, phonons, dielectric response, or another target observable.

stages.boundary: The 3 by 3 total-energy matrix is not a transferable cutoff/k-mesh recommendation and does not establish DOS, phonon, dielectric, or band convergence.

stages.label: Establish the reference geometry
stages.purpose: Inspect the separately recorded fixed-cell relaxation before deciding whether a geometry is an acceptable reference.
stages.boundary: The public bundle does not establish relax-output to static-SCF input lineage, accepted ionic convergence, stability, or the lowest relevant structure.

action.label: Create a static input from the inspected final geometry
commands: test -s "$relax_output"; grep -Fqx '   JOB DONE.' "$relax_output"; grep -F 'bfgs converged' "$relax_output"; test ! -e "$reference"
ACCEPT_RELAX_GEOMETRY=${ACCEPT_RELAX_GEOMETRY:?After inspecting the final force block, criteria, constraints, and coordinates, set ACCEPT_RELAX_GEOMETRY=yes}
awk '/^Begin final coordinates/{seen=1; next} seen && /^ATOMIC_POSITIONS/{print; getline; print; getline; print; exit}' "$relax_output" > "$reference/final-positions.inc"

awk 'FNR==NR {replacement[++n]=$0; next} /^ATOMIC_POSITIONS[[:space:]]/ {for (i=1; i<=n; i++) print replacement[i]; skip=2; next} skip {skip--; next} {print}' "$reference/final-positions.inc" "$case_root/input/scf.in" > "$reference/static-scf.in"
action.boundary: The direct transformation copies only the final two-site ATOMIC_POSITIONS block into a new static template and leaves the fixed cell unchanged. Inspect the displayed block and diff before proceeding; this does not establish scientific acceptance or historical stored lineage.

stages.label: Calculate the reference SCF state
stages.purpose: Inspect the electronic reference calculation independently of relaxation and downstream observables.
stages.boundary: Electronic convergence in the named SCF outputs does not establish relax-to-SCF lineage, target-observable convergence, or scientific acceptance.

action.label: Run and inspect the new static SCF
commands: QE_PW=${QE_PW:?Set QE_PW to the absolute path to pw.x}
action.boundary: These checks cover this process, its reported electronic convergence, stderr size, and the expected save tree only. Geometry acceptance, numerical convergence, observable convergence, and scientific support remain separate.

stages.label: Calculate bands and DOS
stages.purpose: Follow the line-path, nominal-grid, and uniform-mesh DOS branches as distinct target calculations.

action.label: Inspect the stored bands and DOS as separate evidence
commands: for output in bands-pw.out bandsx-main.out dos-nscf.out dosx.out; do test -s "$case_root/output/$output"; grep -nE 'JOB DONE|convergence has been achieved|c_bands|Error in routine' "$case_root/output/$output" || true; done

printf '%s\n' 'The fresh static SCF is not the parent of these stored files. Prepare new compatible bands and uniform-NSCF/DOS inputs against the fresh prefix/outdir/save tree before any fresh downstream run.'
action.boundary: This is stored-evidence inspection only. No fresh bands or DOS command is supplied, and the older data must not be relabelled as descendants of the new static SCF.

stages.boundary: The line path retains solver warnings, and the nominal 8x8x8 route is a 260-point time-reversal-reduced sample. Neither branch establishes a converged fundamental gap or DOS. The fresh route stops after static SCF until compatible downstream inputs are prepared and reviewed.

stages.label: Rebuild tables and plots
stages.purpose: Open the public teaching figures beside their source tables, inspect the axes, references, warnings, and visible trends, then regenerate them from the stored raw-output record if needed.
command_stages: rebuild derived artifacts from stored outputs
stages.boundary: A reconstructed figure verifies the stored parser path, not a fresh execution or an independently converged observable.

action.label: Inspect the stored tables behind the teaching figures
action.boundary: These tables feed the displayed stored-evidence figures. They are not outputs of the new static SCF and do not establish target-observable convergence or a scientific claim.

stages.label: Interpret within the evidence boundary
stages.purpose: Read the real figures, parsed samples, raw anomalies, warnings, sampling policy, relevant literature, and explicit non-claims together.

action.label: Read the stored result boundaries before writing a conclusion
action.boundary: Retain every warning and NOT TESTED field. The next defensible action is to run the missing observable-specific convergence or physics test, not to strengthen the claim from the existing plots.

stages.boundary: The evidence does not support a converged gap, DOS, stability result, experimental agreement, or material-level conclusion.

stages.label: Preserve the reproducible record
stages.purpose: Keep the human decision record, source/browser receipt, visual inspection notes, inputs, outputs, figures, hashes, parsers, environment, routes, and non-claims together.
stages.boundary: The public record preserves assembled evidence and claim boundaries, not one historical launcher, case-wide shell exits, cross-route save trees, or the private Maxwell replay.

action.label: Write a bounded record beside the fresh calculation
commands: test -s "$runtime/relax/si-relax.in"; test -s "$runtime/relax/si-relax.out"; test -s "$runtime/reference/static-scf.in"; test -s "$runtime/reference/static-scf.out"; test ! -e "$record"; test ! -e "$sums"

printf '%s\n' 'Question: inspect a fresh fixed-cell Si relaxation and its descendant static SCF.' 'Decision: retain the final geometry only after human force, criteria, constraint, and coordinate inspection.' 'Boundary: this fresh route stops after static SCF; no fresh bands or DOS were prepared or run.' > "$record"
action.boundary: This preserves the question, decision, explicit stopping point, selected inputs/outputs, geometry handoff, and byte identities. It is not a universal package schema, a regeneration claim, or scientific validation.

workflows.title: Aluminium Metallic Electronic-Structure Workflow
workflows.summary: Follow an explicit fcc Aluminium teaching model through metallic setup, real QE SCF/full-zone/DOS branches, convergence and E(V) screens, plots, and bounded interpretation.
workflows.evidence_boundary: Program completion, SCF convergence, ionic convergence, expected-artifact presence, target-observable convergence, and scientific support are separate decisions.
workflows.continuity_boundary: The public case assembles several real QE 7.5 routes. Only isolated-dos-route is continuous; the case as a whole does not claim one historical launcher, case-wide shell-exit transcript, execution interval, or cross-route save-tree ancestry.
workflows.claim_boundary: This bounded case does not establish one case-wide historical launcher, a converged DOS, Fermi surface, equation of state, elastic property, carrier density, transport result, universal parameter recommendation, or a material-level conclusion.

first_action.label: Inspect the explicit Aluminium model and exact pseudopotential receipt
first_action.boundary: The structure is an explicit teaching input rather than a database identity, and the receipt establishes pseudopotential bytes rather than transferability or numerical suitability.

execution_contexts.label: Local interactive execution
execution_contexts.allowed_when: Only when local and site policy permits calculation on the current machine and sufficient resources are available.
execution_contexts.boundary: Never assume that an SSH login shell or cluster login node is a permitted compute context. The published Aluminium run.sh invokes the supplied executables directly and does not claim a multi-rank launcher.

execution_contexts.label: Slurm allocation or batch execution
execution_contexts.allowed_when: Only inside an active compute allocation or a site-approved batch job.
execution_contexts.boundary: Use the site's documented launcher and resource policy. Do not present the current direct-executable run.sh as a reviewed multi-rank Slurm wrapper.

audit: Retain the NSCF and bands c_bands warnings.
Keep the Gaussian raw-NSCF representation distinct from native dos.x output.

evidence_tracks.boundary: Stored reconstruction supports route-scoped parser and artifact lineage only, not case-wide historical continuity, target-observable convergence, or scientific acceptance.

for output in scf.out nscf-full.out dos.out bands.out; do test -s "$RUN_OUTPUT_ROOT/$output"; grep -nE 'JOB DONE|convergence has been achieved|c_bands|Error in routine' "$RUN_OUTPUT_ROOT/$output" || true; done
evidence_tracks.output_policy: Use a new caller-selected external runtime directory; never overwrite or relabel committed output/, derived/, or figures/ as the new run.
audit: Record the shell exit and inspect every stdout and stderr independently.
Check program termination separately from SCF convergence and retained NSCF/bands warnings.
Confirm the SCF, full-zone NSCF, native dos.x table, and path outputs before parsing.
Do not infer ionic convergence because this bounded case contains no relaxation.
Test DOS, band, or Fermi-surface observables with their own numerical convergence protocol.

evidence_tracks.boundary: This present-day route creates new external SCF, full-zone NSCF, dos.x, and path-bands process records under the exact QE_PW, QE_DOS, QE_PSEUDO_DIR, and RUN_OUTPUT_ROOT contract. No relaxation is part of the case, and no private replay or case-wide historical continuity is claimed.

source_records.label: Explicit fcc Aluminium teaching model
identity: explicit teaching input; not a database identity
source_records.boundary: The explicit input is the bounded reference geometry. It is not a relaxed, database-ranked, or experimentally validated structure.

source_records.label: Public Quantum ESPRESSO Aluminium UPF receipt
source_records.boundary: The exact public URL, byte count, and hash establish file identity only, not transferability, cutoff convergence, or scientific suitability.

record_conflicts.boundary: The pseudopotential metadata and README record the exact public URL receipt verified on 2026-08-09, while qe_plan.json retains an older unverified-URL statement. Do not claim that all case records agree until that plan is reconciled.

stages.label: Identify the structure source
stages.purpose: Recognize that this case starts from an explicit teaching input with no database or experimental identity, then inspect the fcc structure before calculation.

action.label: Inspect the explicit Aluminium source record
action.boundary: The case begins from an explicit teaching model. There is no database or experimental source identity to infer.

stages.boundary: The structure is an explicit one-atom fcc teaching input, not a database or experimental identity.

stages.label: Inspect the computational model
stages.purpose: Visualize and inspect the one-atom fcc primitive model shared by the electronic routes, including its cell and periodic interpretation.

action.label: Compare the cell and atomic model across route inputs
commands: for input in scf.in nscf.in bands.in; do printf '\n### %s\n' "$input"; grep -nE 'ibrav|celldm|nat|ntyp|ATOMIC_SPECIES|ATOMIC_POSITIONS|K_POINTS' "$case_root/input/$input"; done
action.boundary: Matching recorded cell labels support route consistency only. The geometry was not relaxed or independently validated.

stages.boundary: celldm(1)=7.653 bohr is a recorded teaching geometry, not an independently optimized or universal value.

stages.label: Obtain and verify the pseudopotential
stages.purpose: Open the public Quantum ESPRESSO potential record, inspect its metadata and method compatibility, then acquire the exact UPF and reject any byte mismatch.

action.label: Download and verify the exact Aluminium potential
action.boundary: The byte count and SHA-256 establish the acquired file identity only. Retain the stale qe_plan URL conflict; identity does not establish transferability or numerical suitability.

stages.boundary: Use the newer exact URL/bytes/hash receipt and retain the stale qe_plan conflict; file identity does not establish scientific suitability.

stages.label: Prepare the Quantum ESPRESSO inputs
stages.purpose: Inspect the metallic occupations, smearing, cutoff, sampling, prefix, and output ancestry before execution.

action.label: Read the metallic inputs and ancestry before execution
commands: for input in scf.in nscf.in dos.in bands.in; do printf '\n### %s\n' "$input"; sed -n '1,180p' "$case_root/input/$input"; done
action.boundary: Confirm prefix, outdir, calculation type, occupations, smearing, cutoffs, k sampling, and dos.x window. The displayed settings remain unaccepted teaching values.

stages.boundary: PBE, 30/240 Ry, Marzari-Vanderbilt smearing, degauss=0.02 Ry, and 8x8x8 are recorded settings, not converged prescriptions.

stages.label: Run the calculation
stages.purpose: Execute SCF, full-zone NSCF, dos.x, and path bands in the declared isolated order.

action.label: Run SCF, full-zone NSCF, dos.x, and path bands
commands: QE_PW=${QE_PW:?Set QE_PW to the absolute path to pw.x}
QE_DOS=${QE_DOS:?Set QE_DOS to the absolute path to dos.x}
action.boundary: The runner refuses missing executables, a missing or wrong-hash UPF, an existing destination, or a destination inside committed case evidence. A new run creates new evidence.

stages.boundary: Only isolated-dos-route is continuous. The initial captured outputs and later screens are separate routes, and a new run creates new evidence.

stages.label: Check program and solver outcomes
stages.purpose: Inspect exits, JOB DONE markers, stderr, SCF convergence, retained warnings, and expected artifacts separately.

action.label: Inspect the fresh process records and retained warnings
commands: for output in scf.out nscf-full.out dos.out bands.out; do test -s "$RUN_OUTPUT_ROOT/$output"; printf '\n### %s\n' "$output"; grep -nE 'JOB DONE|convergence has been achieved|c_bands|Error in routine' "$RUN_OUTPUT_ROOT/$output" || true; done
for err in scf.err nscf-full.err dos.err bands.err; do wc -c "$RUN_OUTPUT_ROOT/$err"; done
action.boundary: Normal termination, electronic SCF convergence, retained c_bands warnings, stderr, and expected artifacts are separate observations. None establishes observable convergence.

stages.boundary: Normal exits and a DOS file do not erase c_bands warnings or establish observable convergence.

stages.label: Test the required numerical convergence
stages.purpose: Read the real k-mesh/smearing screen as a bounded negative teaching result.

action.label: Read the adverse convergence result before proceeding
action.boundary: The next scientific action is to redesign and run a convergence study suited to the intended observable. Do not convert this FAIL into program failure, observable convergence, or scientific rejection.

stages.boundary: Five SCF programs completed, but the exploratory screen failed its own energy/Fermi thresholds. This is not a program failure, an observable-convergence result, or scientific rejection.

stages.label: Identify the reference geometry
stages.purpose: State explicitly which geometry feeds the electronic routes when no relaxation is part of the case.
stages.boundary: No ionic or cell relaxation is included. The reference is the explicit one-atom fcc teaching geometry, not a relaxed, ranked, or experimentally validated state.

stages.label: Calculate the reference SCF state
stages.purpose: Establish the route-scoped electronic state used by the full-zone NSCF and downstream branches.

action.label: Inspect the fresh reference SCF
commands: grep -nE 'convergence has been achieved|JOB DONE|Error in routine' "$RUN_OUTPUT_ROOT/scf.out"
action.boundary: This checks the fresh SCF process and reported electronic convergence only. The explicit geometry was not relaxed, and target observables remain unconverged.

stages.boundary: The isolated SCF reports electronic convergence, not structural relaxation, target-observable convergence, or scientific acceptance.

stages.label: Calculate bands and DOS
stages.purpose: Follow the continuous SCF to full-zone NSCF to native dos.x route and the later path-band branch.

action.label: Inspect the fresh native DOS and path outputs
action.boundary: The native table and path stdout are fresh artifacts from the declared route. One sampling choice, normal exit, and a nonempty table do not establish DOS, band, or Fermi-surface convergence.

stages.boundary: The save tree is not published, NSCF and bands warnings remain visible, and one 8x8x8 DOS sample does not establish a converged DOS or Fermi surface.

stages.label: Rebuild tables and plots
stages.purpose: Open the native dos.x, raw-NSCF, convergence, and bounded E(V) views with their source tables, inspect what each representation shows, then regenerate them from committed evidence if needed.
stages.boundary: The Gaussian representation, native dos.x plot, sampling histogram, and E(V) fit are distinct derived views; none is convergence evidence by itself.

action.label: Inspect the stored tables behind the retained figures
action.boundary: These are stored route-scoped tables and a bounded fit record, not plots derived from the new runtime. Inspect the fresh al.dos directly until a reviewed fresh plotting route is supplied.

stages.label: Interpret within the evidence boundary
stages.purpose: Read route-scoped figures and tables together with raw warnings, the exploratory FAIL, relevant literature, and explicit non-claims.

action.label: Write the conclusion from the adverse record
action.boundary: Report the exploratory convergence screen as FAIL and observable convergence as not tested. The bounded E(V) fit is mathematical evidence only; the adverse screen is not scientific rejection.

stages.boundary: The case does not support a converged DOS, Fermi surface, EOS, elastic property, carrier density, transport result, universal parameter recommendation, or material conclusion.

stages.label: Preserve the reproducible record
stages.purpose: Keep the human decision record, model inspection notes, route-scoped inputs, outputs, figures, hashes, commands, source receipts, parsers, warnings, and non-claims together.

action.label: Write a bounded record beside the fresh route
commands: test -s "$RUN_OUTPUT_ROOT/scf.in"; test -s "$RUN_OUTPUT_ROOT/scf.out"; test -s "$RUN_OUTPUT_ROOT/nscf-full.out"; test -s "$RUN_OUTPUT_ROOT/al.dos"; test -s "$RUN_OUTPUT_ROOT/bands.out"; test ! -e "$record"; test ! -e "$sums"

printf '%s\n' 'Question: inspect one fresh fcc-Al SCF to full-zone NSCF to dos.x route plus path bands.' 'Boundary: no relaxation is included; DOS, bands, and Fermi-surface convergence are not tested.' 'Stored adverse result: the separate exploratory convergence screen is FAIL, not program failure or scientific rejection.' > "$record"

stages.boundary: The public record preserves assembled route evidence and its conflict/non-claim boundaries, not one case-wide historical launcher or unpublished save-tree ancestry.
